say:1:1320744001:1.text: Though you don't look like how I imagined, I like the real you even more!
say:1:1320744001:1.source_cn: 虽然你长得和我想象中不一样，但我更喜欢真实的你！
say:1:1320744001:1.male: Though you don't look like how I imagined, I like the real you even more!
say:1:1320744001:1.female: Though you don't look like how I imagined, I like the real you even more!

say:2:1320744002:1.text: Uncle Lorsan told me you helped him collect the crystals. Thank you!
say:2:1320744002:1.source_cn: 洛桑哥哥和我说了，是你帮忙采集了那些冰晶石，谢谢你！
say:2:1320744002:1.male: Uncle Lorsan told me you helped him collect the crystals. Thank you!
say:2:1320744002:1.female: Uncle Lorsan told me you helped him collect the crystals. Thank you!

choice_prompt:3:1320744002.source_cn: 洛桑哥哥和我说了，是你帮忙采集了那些冰晶石，谢谢你！
choice_prompt:3:1320744002.male: Uncle Lorsan told me you helped him collect the crystals. Thank you!
choice_prompt:3:1320744002.female: Uncle Lorsan told me you helped him collect the crystals. Thank you!

say:4:1320744003:1.text: Yup! The hot spring may have some magic after all. Two days ago, I started seeing light. Yesterday, I could make out shapes. And this morning, everything is crystal clear!
say:4:1320744003:1.source_cn: 嗯！这里的温泉说不定真的有魔力，前天我渐渐能感受到光了...
say:4:1320744003:1.male: Yup! The hot spring may have some magic after all. Two days ago, I started seeing light. Yesterday, I could make out shapes. And this morning, everything is crystal clear!
say:4:1320744003:1.female: Yup! The hot spring may have some magic after all. Two days ago, I started seeing light. Yesterday, I could make out shapes. And this morning, everything is crystal clear!

say:5:1320744004:1.text: I never would've guessed Lorsan had rabbit ears...
say:5:1320744004:1.source_cn: 真没想到，洛桑哥哥竟然有一对兔子耳朵。

say:6:1320744005:1.text: The real world may look different from what you envisioned, but I promise it's even more beautiful.
say:6:1320744005:1.source_cn: 那些真实的景色肯定也和你想象中不一样，但是我保证，它们...

say:7:1320744006:1.text: When I grow up, I'll go see it for myself!
say:7:1320744006:1.source_cn: 等我长大后，我会去看看的！

say:8:1320744007:1.text: Until then, I won't sneak out anymore. I'll focus on learning proper adventure skills so Mom doesn't have to worry anymore.
say:8:1320744007:1.source_cn: 在那之前，我不能偷偷乱跑，我要继续学习冒险技能，不能让...

say:10:1320744009:1.text: Don't be so surprised, ma'am. Kids have a way of growing up all at once.
say:10:1320744009:1.source_cn: 娜杰卡女士，不用太惊讶，孩子都是在突然间成长起来的。

say:11:1320744010:1.text: I don't know how to thank you... Please, take this as a token of our gratitude.
say:11:1320744010:1.source_cn: 真不知道怎么感谢你们才好……洛桑先生，请你务必收下这个。

say:13:1320744011:1.text: A sapphirine bouquet? Wow, it's beautiful. Thank you, I'll treasure it!
say:13:1320744011:1.source_cn: 蓝绒花？谢谢，我会好好珍藏。

say:14:1320744012:1.text: We're heading out now. We wish you all the best.
say:14:1320744012:1.source_cn: 我们走了，愿你们一切顺利。

narration:17:1320744014:0.text: After seeing Nadeen and Bavier off, Lorsan prepares to send a gift and a letter back to the Dark Forest.
narration:17:1320744014:0.source_cn: 送别娜杰卡和巴维尔后，洛桑准备把礼物和写好的信寄回薄暮丛林
narration:17:1320744014:0.male: After seeing Nadeen and Bavier off, Lorsan prepares to send a gift and a letter back to the Dark Forest.
narration:17:1320744014:0.female: After seeing Nadeen and Bavier off, Lorsan prepares to send a gift and a letter back to the Dark Forest.

say:19:1320744015:1.text: There's so much I want to say to Lyca. I ended up writing a really long letter. My handwriting got so messy near the end... Hopefully she can still read it!
say:19:1320744015:1.source_cn: 想告诉莱卡的事情太多了，我写了好长好长的一封信啊，写到...
say:19:1320744015:1.male: There's so much I want to say to Lyca. I ended up writing a really long letter. My handwriting got so messy near the end... Hopefully she can still read it!
say:19:1320744015:1.female: There's so much I want to say to Lyca. I ended up writing a really long letter. My handwriting got so messy near the end... Hopefully she can still read it!

say:21:1320744016:1.text: You're right, I bet she can read my handwriting no matter how messy!
say:21:1320744016:1.source_cn: 你说得对，她一定能看懂。
say:21:1320744016:1.male: You're right, I bet she can read my handwriting no matter how messy!
say:21:1320744016:1.female: You're right, I bet she can read my handwriting no matter how messy!

say:22:1320744017:1.text: Oh, and I tucked one of the sapphirine blossoms in there too. I asked Lyca to put it in my room.
say:22:1320744017:1.source_cn: 我把娜杰卡女士给我的蓝绒花也一起寄回去了，我让莱卡把那...
say:22:1320744017:1.male: Oh, and I tucked one of the sapphirine blossoms in there too. I asked Lyca to put it in my room.
say:22:1320744017:1.female: Oh, and I tucked one of the sapphirine blossoms in there too. I asked Lyca to put it in my room.

say:23:1320744018:1.text: That way, when I return to the Dark Forest, it'll be waiting for me.
say:23:1320744018:1.source_cn: 等我回到薄暮丛林的时候，那朵花会对我说：欢迎回家。
say:23:1320744018:1.male: That way, when I return to the Dark Forest, it'll be waiting for me.
say:23:1320744018:1.female: That way, when I return to the Dark Forest, it'll be waiting for me.

say:24:1320744019:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll be leaving here soon as well. Before that, I hope you'll visit me a few more times.
say:24:1320744019:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll be leaving here soon as well. Before that, I hope you'll visit me a few more times.
say:24:1320744019:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll be leaving here soon as well. Before that, I hope you'll visit me a few more times.

choice_prompt:25:1320744019.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，再过不久我也会离开这里了，在那之前，希望你能多来几次。

say:26:1320744020:1.text: I'm already looking forward to it!
say:26:1320744020:1.male: I'm already looking forward to it!
say:26:1320744020:1.female: I'm already looking forward to it!

say:27:1320744022:1.text: But before the next farewell, whenever it may come, I hope we'll meet again.
say:27:1320744022:1.source_cn: 在下一次不知何时才能再见的分别到来前，希望能多与你见面。
say:27:1320744022:1.male: But before the next farewell, whenever it may come, I hope we'll meet again.
say:27:1320744022:1.female: But before the next farewell, whenever it may come, I hope we'll meet again.

say:28:1320744023:1.source_cn: 要常来啊，我会等着你的！

say:30:1320744021:1.text: I understand; you're Magister Merlin, after all! People must be lining up to hang out with you.
say:30:1320744021:1.source_cn: 我知道，毕竟你是梅林啊。
